competency.outcome: Teach another learner to reason about offline rl using an offline policy evaluation study. Fix a time, memory and energy budget before the run.

topic_kernel.measure: estimated versus observed return on supported actions

competency.practice_task: Produce a lesson, coached exercise and blind learner transfer test grounded in an offline policy evaluation study.
competency.setting_constraint: Fix a time, memory and energy budget before the run.
required_evidence: a lesson, coached exercise and blind learner transfer test
Include resource log and quality per unit of compute.
Report estimated versus observed return on supported actions with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: extrapolating beyond dataset support.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of offline rl.
Practice: the learner succeeds on a new case without the answer key.
Measurement: report estimated versus observed return on supported actions against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for extrapolating beyond dataset support; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
